# Baton

> Local run control plane and MCP server for launching, hot-reloading, inspecting, and capturing evidence across Flutter and web apps — one target, or a whole declared local system.

Baton replaces the IDE Run & Debug toolbar with a loopback daemon. People use `baton` and `baton app`. Any MCP-compatible agent uses `baton-mcp` or the same CLI.

## Install

- GitHub: `npm install -g github:kanumuri9593/Baton#v0.2.6`
- npm: `npm install -g baton-run`
- MCP: command `baton-mcp`
- Control panel: `baton app` (`baton hud` is a compatibility alias)
- Node.js 24+, MIT license, macOS / Linux / Windows
- Repo: https://github.com/kanumuri9593/Baton

## Agent docs

- https://github.com/kanumuri9593/Baton/blob/main/AGENTS.md
- https://github.com/kanumuri9593/Baton/blob/main/README.md

- Labs: examples/flutter-lab, examples/workflow-lab

## Workspaces

- `baton.workspace.json` declares a system: nodes, `dependsOn`, and per-node providers (`target`, `compose`, `remote`).
- CLI: `baton up`, `baton down`, `baton status`, `baton switch <node> <provider>`, `baton restart <node> [--cascade]`.
- MCP: `start_workspace`, `stop_workspace`, `workspace_status`, `switch_provider`, `restart_node`. `run_workflow` is the legacy flat form.
- Baton stops only what it started; remote and already-running nodes are reported as `external`.
